Yes. Monzo is designed to work as a UK main current account: you can have your salary paid in, set up Direct Debits and standing orders for bills, and use its budgeting tools to keep bill money separate from everyday spending.
monzo

What it supports

Salary: Ask your employer to pay into your Monzo account. If paid by Bacs, Monzo says it can make the money available one business day early.
monzo

Bills: You can set up Direct Debits and standing orders from Monzo, including from a dedicated Bills Pot.
monzo

Budgeting: Salary Sorter automatically splits incoming salary into Pots for bills, spending, and savings; Monzo gives the example of dividing a £1,600 payment into rent, bills, savings, and spending money.
monzo

Switching: The Current Account Switch Service can move balances, Direct Debits, standing orders, and redirect incoming payments—including salary—to Monzo, and close your old account.
monzo

“Main account” benefits

Monzo treats an account as your main account if, for example, you receive at least £500 every 35 days and have an active Direct Debit, or receive certain DWP/Communities payments. This matters because some Monzo features or fee-free allowances depend on it being your main account.
moneytothemasses

Practical setup

Open a Monzo personal current account.

Give your employer Monzo’s account details, or use the full switch service.

Create a Bills Pot and move enough money into it on payday for rent, utilities, subscriptions, and other regular payments.

Point your Direct Debits and standing orders at that Bills Pot.

Keep a separate spending balance or Pot so bills cannot be accidentally spent.

Things to consider

Monzo is app-based and has no traditional branch network, so it may be less convenient if you regularly pay in cash or cheques. A sensible approach is to use Monzo as your primary account if that suits you, while retaining a second account with a different provider as a backup for cash deposits, cheque payments, or access issues.
community.monzo

For most UK employees, using Monzo for salary and bills is entirely viable—provided you keep enough in the Bills Pot before each Direct Debit date and maintain a backup payment method.
